content_zh:
沈长青的记忆中并没有关于武学的知识，而且他为人懒惰打小就不喜欢花费体力去练功，甚至于连自己祖传的武功都没练过，因此陈浩对这个世界的武力值没什么了解。
陈浩原本以为这方世界是有内功存在的，所以才想让沈炼教他内功。
可是见沈炼一副懵懂的样子，陈浩心中一凉，沈炼在绣春刀世界算是高手了，他都没听说过内功真气，那十有八九此方世界就没有真气的存在！
“内家真气是一种能量体，武者通过修炼内功心法汲取天地灵气，将灵气吸收到体内供养自身，据说武者一旦修炼出真气身体就会发生天翻地覆的变化，一些将真气修炼到极致的人可以翻江倒海、以一敌万......”他只能凭借着前世看过的小说和自己的臆想跟沈炼解释。
“停，别说了！”沈炼打断了陈浩的话，看向陈浩的眼神仿佛再看一个弱智。
“翻江倒海？以一敌万？”沈炼拍了拍陈浩的肩膀，语重心长的说道：“西游释厄传的话本可不能再多看了，能把人看傻的......”
沈炼说罢便回屋了，转身的时候不忘还小声嘟囔，说是卫所老刘家的姑娘就因为看话本看傻了，抛弃父母跟人私奔了！
见沈炼将内家真气归结到神话小说里，陈浩失望了，这方世界真的没有内功与真气了。
不过他也没有丧失信心，他明白第一个穿越的世界只是低等世界，下一个世界说不定就有内功真气的存在了。
对于修炼陈浩还是很自信的，毕竟身怀侠客系统，只要有足够的侠客点，那他就能无限升级。
沈炼只在屋里待了一会，然后就走了出来，他的肩上还背着一个麻袋。
“铛！”
走到陈浩对面时，沈炼将肩上的麻袋扔在了地上，恰好砸在了地上放着的铁盆上，两者相撞竟传出了金属相撞的声音。
“这是铁鞋？”只见一双用铁鞋从麻袋中滑落了出来，陈浩还是第一次亲眼见到用金属打造的鞋子！
“不错!”沈炼点头承认，他指着地上的铁鞋道：“两只铁鞋各三十斤重，是专门练习“八步赶蝉的辅助工具！”
“一般来说，练功都是从小开始练，练八步赶蝉也是如此，家里还有几双小孩、与少年用的铁鞋，重量都要比眼前的这一双轻，但是你现在年及弱冠，小号的鞋你肯定穿不下去，所以只能从三十斤重的鞋练起！”
三十斤？陈浩有些惊讶，心说古人还真会虐待人啊！
前世陈浩在电视上见过穿铁鞋表演的，而且还申请了吉尼斯纪录，但是他们走的却很慢犹如蜗牛爬一样，他觉得沈炼的要求肯定要比那些所谓的吉尼斯纪录保持者高出很多。
“好了，不要废话了，快过来穿上。”沈炼幸灾乐祸的说道，要是让明时坊卫所的下属看到肯定会大跌眼镜，这还是他们冷酷严肃的大人吗！
陈浩到是不在意有多累，想当初在孤儿院他为了学习军体拳给退伍的厨师按摩了半年，一双铁鞋还难不倒他！

这是陈浩穿上铁鞋时的第一感觉，他的双脚像是被套上了沉重的枷锁，走动起来更是艰难无比，每一次抬脚都要付出巨大的体力，不一会陈浩就热得满头大汗。
不过陈浩没有停下，哪怕汗水浸透了上衣，他依然一步一步艰难的往前移动。
“当你能穿着这双铁鞋如履平地时，八步赶蝉就算是练成了。”沈炼一脸笑意的看着陈浩练功，心里十分满意。
陈浩没听清沈炼在说什么，他全神贯注的练习踩铁鞋，口中传出剧烈的喘息声。
“停！”
一炷香的时间后，沈炼叫停了陈浩。
见沈炼叫停，陈浩一屁股坐在了地上，连忙揉了揉酸疼的脚，脚面上竟红肿了起来。
沈炼仿佛没看到陈浩红肿的脚面，他道：“从今日起，每天练习一炷香的八步赶蝉和半个时辰的沈家刀法。”
说着沈炼从旁边的凳子上拿了一把刀，噌的一声，一道白光闪过，刀已出鞘，丝毫不给陈浩休息时间。
“沈家刀法一共有九式，每一式都是咱们老祖宗归纳总结出来的，你且认真看着，沈炼一边给陈浩演练招式，一边与其讲述：“第一式力劈华山!”
“啪！”

content_en:
Shen Changqing had no knowledge of martial arts in his memory, and he was lazy and didn't like to spend energy practicing martial arts since he was a child. He had never even practiced the martial arts passed down by his ancestors. Therefore, Chen Hao had little understanding of the value of martial arts in this world.
Chen Hao originally thought that inner strength existed in this world, so he wanted Shen Lian to teach him inner strength.
But seeing Shen Lian's confused look, Chen Hao felt a chill in his heart. Shen Lian was considered a master in the world of Xiuchundao. He had never heard of internal energy and true qi, so there was a high probability that there was no true qi in this world!
"Inner family's true energy is an energy body. Warriors absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth through practicing internal skills and mental methods, and absorb the spiritual energy into their bodies to support themselves. It is said that once a warrior cultivates true energy, his body will undergo earth-shaking changes. Some people who have cultivated true energy to the extreme can overturn rivers and seas, and defeat ten thousand people with one person..." He could only rely on the novels he had read in his previous life and his own imagination to explain to Shen Lian.
"Stop, stop talking!" Shen Lian interrupted Chen Hao and looked at Chen Hao as if he was looking at another mentally retarded person.
"Trouble the river? One against ten thousand?" Shen Lian patted Chen Hao's shoulder and said seriously: "You can't read more about Journey to the West. It can make people look stupid..."
After saying that, Shen Lian went back to the house. When he turned around, he muttered in a low voice that the girl from Liu's family, the old man in the guard house, was so stupid because of reading the book that she abandoned her parents and ran away with someone!
Chen Hao was disappointed when he saw that Shen Lian attributed the internal energy to mythical novels. There really was no internal energy and internal energy in this world.
However, he did not lose confidence. He understood that the first world he traveled through was just a lower world, and the next world might contain internal energy and true energy.
Chen Hao is still very confident in practicing. After all, he has the knight system. As long as he has enough knight points, he can upgrade infinitely.
Shen Lian only stayed in the room for a while, and then walked out, carrying a sack on his shoulders.
"Cang!"
When he walked across from Chen Hao, Shen Lian threw the sack on his shoulder on the ground, and it happened to hit the iron basin on the ground. The collision between the two made the sound of metal colliding.
"Are these iron shoes?" A pair of iron shoes slipped out of the sack. This was the first time Chen Hao saw shoes made of metal with his own eyes!
"Not bad!" Shen Lian nodded and admitted. He pointed to the iron shoes on the ground and said: "The two iron shoes weigh thirty kilograms each. They are specialized auxiliary tools for practicing "eight steps to catch cicadas!" "
"Generally speaking, you should start practicing martial arts from a young age, and the same goes for practicing eight steps to catch cicadas. There are several pairs of iron shoes used by children and teenagers at home, which are lighter than the pair in front of you. But since you are young and weak now, you will definitely not be able to wear small shoes, so you can only start practicing with shoes that weigh thirty kilograms! "
Thirty pounds? Chen Hao was a little surprised, thinking that the ancients really knew how to abuse people!
In his previous life, Chen Hao had seen people performing in iron shoes on TV, and they even applied for Guinness records, but they walked very slowly, like a snail crawling. He felt that Shen Lian's requirements must be much higher than those of the so-called Guinness record holders.
"Okay, stop talking nonsense, come here and put it on. "Shen Lian said with gloating, if the subordinates of Mingshifang Health Center saw it, they would definitely be shocked. Is this still their cold and serious adult?
Chen Hao didn't care how tired he was. He remembered that when he was in the orphanage, he massaged a retired chef for half a year in order to learn military martial arts boxing. A pair of iron shoes couldn't stop him!
This was Chen Hao's first feeling when he put on the iron shoes. His feet seemed to be covered with heavy shackles, and it was even more difficult to move around. Every time he lifted his feet, he had to exert a huge amount of energy. After a while, Chen Hao was sweating profusely from the heat.
But Chen Hao didn't stop. Even though his shirt was soaked with sweat, he still moved forward step by step with difficulty.
"When you can walk on flat ground wearing these iron shoes, you will be considered accomplished in chasing cicadas in eight steps. "Shen Lian watched Chen Hao practice with a smile on his face, feeling very satisfied.
Chen Hao didn't hear clearly what Shen Lian was saying. He was concentrating on practicing stepping on iron shoes, and he heard heavy breathing from his mouth.
"Stop!"
After a moment of burning incense, Shen Lian stopped Chen Hao.
Seeing Shen Lian telling him to stop, Chen Hao sat down on the ground and quickly rubbed his sore feet, which turned out to be red and swollen.
Shen Lian seemed not to notice Chen Hao's red and swollen feet. He said: "From today on, practice the eight-step cicada-catching technique with a stick of incense and the Shen family sword technique for half an hour every day."
As he spoke, Shen Lian took a knife from the stool next to him. There was a clatter, a white light flashed, and the knife was unsheathed, without giving Chen Hao any time to rest.
"There are nine styles of Shen family swordsmanship. Each style is summed up by our ancestors. Please watch carefully. Shen Lian rehearsed the moves for Chen Hao and told him: "The first style is powerful enough to split Huashan Mountain!"
"Crack! "
